text: Coverage: In this dataset, a domain account disable action with both the acting user and the disabled user is evidenced in ms:aad:audit, and the checked rival feeds o365:management:activity and WinEventLog do not contain a competing disable event for this question.

Selection: The account-disable event that answers the question is the single successful ms:aad:audit 'Disable account' record where fyodor@froth.ly disables bgist@froth.ly by changing AccountEnabled from [true] to [false].
rival: The strongest rivals are the two 'Update user' ms:aad:audit events and any on-prem AD disable event; the report rules them out because only one event is labeled 'Disable account' and rival feeds showed no WinEventLog 4725 or O365 account-disable operation.
